description: This PHP source file defines the ServerRequest class within the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace. It extends the general Request class to implement server-side HTTP request handling and adheres to the PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface. The class includes methods for constructing a server request from globals, normalizing uploaded files, and accessing request parameters such as cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, server parameters, and attributes.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Represents an HTTP server-side request, with methods to access request data, uploaded files, cookies, query params, server params, and request attributes. Includes static methods for creating instances from PHP globals and normalizing uploaded files.

methods.name: normalizeFiles
methods.description: Recursively normalizes the $_FILES array structure into an array of UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: createUploadedFileFromSpec
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile instance from a file specification array, handling nested file arrays.

methods.name: normalizeNestedFileSpec
methods.description: Normalizes nested file upload specifications into an array of UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object populated with PHP superglobals ($_GET, $_POST, $_COOKIE, $_FILES, $_SERVER).

methods.name: getUriFromGlobals
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object based on $_SERVER values.
